bounded_checks.findings:
🟢 The defining published abstract describes surface trapping of secreted proteins followed by oligonucleotide-antibody probing and joint sequencing with transcriptomes. That supports the broad interface,not a full library chemistry. The inspected published SI supplies validation experiments and custom reporters;the defining main's core conjugation,capture,pulse,copying and library Methods remain unread. The small local graph therefore uses explicit opaque source boundaries and remains private/incomplete.

🟢 SupplementaryTable2 antiIFNγ barcode1 is `CCTTGGCACCCGAGAATTCCAACGAGTAGCTCGAGACAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA*A*A`;barcode2 changes the16-base reporter window to `AGATCAAGAAGCTTCG`. Both are physically5′Biotin-TEG modified and have two terminal phosphorothioate links. TheA27 tail is preserved as printed. Barcode1/2 are named source reporter identities;exact temporal pulse assignment is not reconstructed,and neither is assigned a per-RNA UMI meaning. Published SI Fig3 caption202–203 explicitly states covalent antibody–streptavidin coupling before oligo association;the graph preserves those source-supported stages. Exact coupling reagent/site/workup and stoichiometry remain unassembled;no direct covalent antibody–DNA bond or ideal binding occupancy inferred.

🟢 The original table wraps barcode1 after its first11identity bases,and the intervening modification column prints5′Biotin-TEG before continuation `GAGAC...`. The rendered original verifies the complete polymer;local transcription checks independently preserve both fragments and modifications. No synthetic source text or per-strand sourceguard exemption is used for this extraction limitation.

The SI qPCR/FAM-polyT standards,fluorescent saturation assays and cell-array validation establish their stated assay contexts. They do not disclose the missing core NGS reaction order in this pass. In particular,FAM-polyT extension/qPCR is not inserted as a transcriptome-library construction step;fluorescent antibody exchange is not silently converted into sequential DNA reporter pulses. SI Table2 additive/amplification primer names alone are not complete operations or a historical kit recipe.

The model distinguishes secreted protein,cell-surface capture complex,antibody-associated DNA reporter and cellular RNA. It does not convert protein into DNA,declare all unbound reporters removed,predict perfect same-cell secretion capture,or add an unreviewed kit default. Published joint sequencing is represented only as an unresolved source continuation with no invented read configuration.

Access scope: the defining paper identity/abstract was verified at candidate screening. Direct publisher access redirected to an inaccessible Nature identity endpoint;standard source acquisition supplied published SI but no defining main by the bounded inspection. Remaining source PDFs/tables are not promoted to a complete method review. No absence claim is accepted.

Component ancestry: no whole CITE-seq or SEC-seq inheritance is declared from endpoint similarity. Source-specific cell-surface trapping distinguishes this candidate from nanovialSEC-seq;actual core chemistry must be inspected before a stronger component ancestry edge or temporal barcode contract.
